funding.name: entrepreneurship@UBC Seed Fund
funding.source_note:
entrepreneurship@UBC Seed Fund: UBC's donor-backed venture funds, investing in ventures
led by UBC students, faculty, staff, and recent alumni. Published historical check range
$25K-$200K. Innovation UBC office: 103-6190 Agronomy Road (UBC campus).
Sources:
  https://innovation.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-ventures/investors
  https://www.sauder.ubc.ca/news/student-invention-first-secure-seed-money-new-ubc-entrepreneurship-fund
  https://www.innovosource.com/entrepreneurshipubc-seed-fund-advances-university-startups-success/

funding.name: Front Row Ventures
funding.source_note:
Front Row Ventures: Canada's student-run VC fund, invests $50K SAFEs in startups with at
least one student founder; active UBC campus team (fund HQ is in Montreal, hence off_campus).
Sources:
  https://frontrow.ventures/
  https://events.ubc.ca/event/employer-on-campus-info-session-front-row-ventures/
  https://gss.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-already-have-a-startup-where-can-you-find-funding/

funding.name: Futurpreneur Canada
funding.source_note:
Futurpreneur Canada: federally supported nonprofit; startup loans up to $60K (with BDC)
plus two years of mentorship for founders aged 18-39. Listed by UBC's Graduate Student
Society as a funding source for UBC startups.
Sources:
  https://futurpreneur.ca/
  https://gss.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-already-have-a-startup-where-can-you-find-funding/

funding.name: Innovate BC — Innovator Skills Initiative
funding.source_note:
Innovate BC Innovator Skills Initiative: provincial grant of up to $10K for BC tech
companies (including student-founded startups) to hire BC post-secondary students —
the standard first wage subsidy reachable by UBC student ventures. Administered by
New Ventures BC.
Sources:
  https://www.innovatebc.ca/programs/isi/
  https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/employment-business/economic-development/funding-and-grants/innovator-skills-initiative

funding.name: Innovation OnBoard
funding.source_note:
Innovation OnBoard: AMS student-led entrepreneurship program and pitch competition at UBC;
teams of 1-5 UBC students compete for a share of $10K in cash prizes (2025/26 cycle).
Non-dilutive prize money, not an investment fund. AMS club, based out of the Nest.
Sources:
  https://www.innovationboard.ca/ubc.html
  https://events.ubc.ca/event/innovation-fair/
  https://gss.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-already-have-a-startup-where-can-you-find-funding/

funding.name: Mitacs — Accelerate Entrepreneur
funding.source_note:
Mitacs Accelerate Entrepreneur: national program funding student and postdoc entrepreneurs
to intern in their own incorporated startup ($15K per internship unit, half matched by
Mitacs) if housed in an eligible incubator (e.g. entrepreneurship@UBC). Mitacs head office
is on UBC campus at 301-6190 Agronomy Road. Listed by UBC's GSS as UBC startup funding.
Sources:
  https://www.mitacs.ca/our-programs/accelerate-entrepreneur/
  https://gss.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-already-have-a-startup-where-can-you-find-funding/
  https://www.mitacs.ca/contact/

funding.name: New Ventures BC Competition
funding.check_size: share of ~$250K in cash and prizes
funding.source_note:
New Ventures BC Competition: nonprofit-run, Innovate BC-backed annual competition awarding
~$250K in cash and prizes to BC tech startups. NVBC's 2024 annual report counts UBC as
connected to 37 ventures (16%) in that year's competition; listed by UBC's GSS as a
funding source for UBC startups.
Sources:
  https://www.newventuresbc.com/
  https://www.newventuresbc.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/NVBC-Annual-Report-2024_final-1.pdf
  https://gss.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-already-have-a-startup-where-can-you-find-funding/

funding.name: VANTEC Angel Network
funding.source_note:
VANTEC Angel Network: BC's largest angel network (est. 1999), monthly pitch meetings with
open applications. Recurring UBC-ecosystem engagement: co-hosted events with
entrepreneurship@UBC, e@UBC ventures pitch at VANTEC meetings, and VANTEC/WUTIF members
sit on e@UBC pitch-event evaluation committees. Individual member investments are not
published, so specific recent UBC portfolio names are not verifiable from public info.
Sources:
  https://www.vantec.ca/
  https://www.valhallaprivatecap.com/entrepreneurship-british-columbia-pitch-event-ventures-startups
  https://vantechjournal.com/p/enterpreneurship-at-ubc-investor-showcase-2023

funding.name: WUTIF Capital
funding.source_note:
WUTIF Capital: the Western Universities Technology Innovation Fund — evergreen angel fund
(VCC) with an explicit mandate to invest first cheques in early-stage tech ventures
developed at BC's universities, including UBC. Active as of Fall 2026 subscriptions.
Sources:
  https://wutif.ca/
  https://wutif.ca/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/InfoSheet-WUTIF-Nov2020.pdf

programs.name: Academy of Translational Medicine
programs.application_cadence: rolling community membership; annual micro-certificate intakes
programs.source_note:
Source: https://atm.med.ubc.ca/
Source: https://atm.med.ubc.ca/lab2market-validate-foundations/
Faculty of Medicine translational-innovation hub at 2215 Wesbrook Mall.
Listable offerings are training programs (Micro-certificate in Regulatory
Affairs in the Life Sciences; hosts Lab2Market Validate Foundations).
Active: 2026/27 micro-certificate registration open; new director appointed.

programs.name: Applied Science Summer Entrepreneurship Program
programs.source_note:
Source: https://icics.ubc.ca/hatch/apsc-summer-tech-development-entrepreneurship-program/
Free 10-session summer cohort run by APSC and the ICICS HATCH team for
student teams (at least one APSC member). Page advertises the 2026 program
(May 4 - Jul 6 2026, applications closed Mar 31 2026). Sessions online;
program HQ is ICICS, 2366 Main Mall.

programs.name: Creative Destruction Lab - Vancouver
programs.source_note:

Source: https://www.sauder.ubc.ca/thought-leadership/research-outreach-centres/creative-destruction-lab-vancouver
Hosted at UBC Sauder. Streams include Climate, Compute, Minerals, Cancer,
Biomedical Engineering. Nonprofit, no fees, explicitly takes no equity.
Active: 2025/26 applications closed Jul 25 2025; 2026/27 cycle followed.

programs.name: HATCH Venture Builder
programs.source_note:
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-ventures/entrepreneurial-pathways/hatch-venture-builder
Source: https://icics.ubc.ca/hatch/
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/news/february-02-2026/meet-ventures-joining-hatch-venture-builder-winter-2026
Late-stage venture builder for UBC spin-offs that have completed Venture
Founder (non-spin-off UBC teams via ICICS track). Up to 18 months of
residency, office space at ICICS (2366 Main Mall) and UBC Robson Square,
shared wet lab and makerspace. Active: Winter 2026 cohort announced Feb 2026.
No fees or equity terms published.

programs.name: Innovation UBC
programs.source_note:
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/how-engage/commercialization
Consolidated unit under the VP Research and Innovation portfolio covering
sponsored research, inventions and licensing (the former University-Industry
Liaison Office function), and entrepreneurship pathways. Both
entrepreneurship.ubc.ca and uilo.ubc.ca now redirect here, so this entry is
the umbrella plus the tech-transfer front door. Office at 103-6190 Agronomy
Road. Active: updated Express License Agreement for spin-offs launched
Jul 2026; ongoing 2026 events.

programs.name: Lab2Market at UBC
programs.application_cadence: cohorts 1-2x/year plus short Validate Foundations intensives
programs.source_note:
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-ventures/entrepreneurial-pathways/lab2market
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/lab2market-validate
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/news/august-08-2025/applications-are-open-start-your-journey-lab2market
National researcher-commercialization program delivered for BC and Yukon by
Innovation UBC. Validate is a four-month cohort for grad student / PI teams;
Validate Foundations is a 3-day virtual intensive. Active: fall 2025 intake
(applications due Sep 8 2025). Largely virtual; UBC delivery based at the
Innovation UBC office on Agronomy Road.

programs.name: New Venture Design
programs.application_cadence: 1x/year (apply by early July for the September start)
programs.source_note:
Source: https://nvd.ubc.ca/
Source: https://nvd.ubc.ca/application-process/
Source: https://vancouver.calendar.ubc.ca/course-descriptions/courses/apscv-486-new-venture-design
Year-long 6-credit venture-creation course (APSC 486 / COMM 466) jointly
offered by Applied Science and Sauder; mixed engineering-business student
teams build a prototype and business plan. Admission by application.
Active: 2026/27 applications open with a Jul 1 2026 deadline. Delivered on
the engineering side of central campus; zone set to engineering.

programs.name: SBME Innovates
programs.source_note:
Source: https://bme.ubc.ca/partners/research-innovation/sbme-innovates/
Source: https://news.ubc.ca/2025/04/ubc-opens-gordon-b-shrum-biomedical-engineering-building/
School of Biomedical Engineering life-sciences incubator at the Biomedical
Research Centre (Gordon B. Shrum Building, opened Apr 2025). Free dedicated
wet-lab benches, equipment, and mentor/investor network; residencies of
6-24 months; capacity for up to 10 spin-off ventures per year. Active:
expanding capacity in 2026; rolling online interest form.

programs.name: Venture Founder
programs.source_note:
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/entrepreneurship-ventures/entrepreneurial-pathways/venture-founder
Source: https://innovation.ubc.ca/Apply-for-Venture-Founder-Fall-2026
Innovation UBC's flagship 16-week venture program for UBC researchers,
faculty, and students building investable companies; entry requirement for
HATCH Venture Builder. Weekly online sessions with four in-person sessions.
Active: 51st cohort noted; Fall 2026 applications recently closed. Free to
participants; no equity terms published. Run from the Innovation UBC office
on Agronomy Road; zone set to south_campus.

labs.name: Tropini Lab
labs.focus: host-microbiota interactions and gut bacterial biogeography, using microfluidics, imaging and gnotobiotic models
labs.source_note: Joint appointment with Microbiology and Immunology; the group site is hosted on that department domain.

labs.name: UBC CIRRUS Lab
labs.focus: cloud infrastructure and serverless computing: reliability, usability, and sustainability

labs.name: UBC Digital Multimedia Lab
labs.focus: video and multimedia processing: compression, quality enhancement, and deep learning for imaging
labs.source_note: The directory lists this group under a different name against its lead faculty; the group own page presents as UBC Digital Multimedia Lab.

labs.name: UBC Quantum Software and Algorithms Research Group
labs.focus: software and algorithms for quantum computers, including circuit synthesis, quantum system characterization and open source tooling
labs.source_note: The group sits in Electrical and Computer Engineering, so it is zoned there rather than at the institute.

labs.name: UBC Security & Privacy Group
labs.focus: systems security, cloud security, network security, privacy, and security of machine learning and software

labs.name: UBC Tree Molecular Biology Research Lab
labs.focus: tree cell-wall molecular biology, covering cellulose and lignin biosynthesis, secondary xylem formation and wood quality traits
labs.source_note: The department listing names it Wood and Fiber Quality Lab; the site own header is UBC Tree Molecular Biology Research Lab.

labs.name: Williams Lab
labs.focus: extracellular vesicle biology and nanoscale flow cytometry for liquid-biopsy cancer detection and metastasis target discovery
labs.source_note: Site footer still reads 2023; liveness from the publication record.

labs.name: Wisnovsky Lab
labs.focus: chemical biology and functional genomics combining glycobiology, molecular design and immunology to map glycan-binding proteins

labs.name: Yachie Laboratory
labs.focus: DNA-based event recording and single-cell lineage tracing, CRISPR base editors, clone isolation and lab automation
labs.source_note: A dual-site group with a second location at the University of Osaka; the UBC site is in the school building.

labs.name: Ye Research Group
labs.focus: optical spectroscopy and near-field microscopy of emergent phenomena in atomically thin materials and van der Waals stacks
